message: Hello, brother SS INTJ.  I've always felt that the INTJ description fit me better than the sun sun description of being a Gemini because INTJ's are so intense and goal oriented as well as seemingly arrogant ("seemingly" being the key word here), which I am, rather than an unyieldingly cheerful jack of all trades that Gemini's are supposed to be.  The leader in the background characterizes me fairly well, though I really don't want to be a leader--or like leading at all--in the foreground or background.
